title: Warsh Reportedly Considering Reducing Number of Fed Meetings
title_cn: 据报道沃什正在考虑减少美联储会议次数
summary:
Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh is considering reducing the frequency of the central bank’s scheduled policy meetings, the New York Times reported Friday.
Warsh raised the proposal to change the frequency of meetings at this week’s gathering of the Federal Open Market Committee, the paper added.
Bloomberg Managing Editor Kate Davidson said changing the schedule would be the biggest change for Warsh. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Americans Are Richer Than Ever. Why Are They So Angry?

More people are upper-middle class than ever, and even lower-income Americans are richer by almost every measure compared to previous generations. And yet more than three in five Americans say the economy is not working for them." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pentagon Seeks $18.2 Billion in War Funds for Interceptors
title_cn: 五角大楼寻求 182 亿美元的战争资金用于拦截机
summary: The Pentagon’s $67 billion request for emergency funding this fiscal year includes $18.2 billion to replace the US’s most advanced Patriot missile, Navy Tomahawks and the Army’s high-altitude interceptor known as Thaad, according to documents provided to Congress.

title: Trump Puts Immunity From Probes Over His Fight for Blanche
title_cn: 特朗普为布兰奇之争免除调查
summary: President Donald Trump’s desire to avoid the kinds of criminal prosecutions he faced the last time he left office has become the biggest impediment to getting his own attorney general pick confirmed by the US Senate.
